transcript: Grandma, it's me, Jake. I got arrested after a car accident and I need $2,500 for bail right now. Please get Walmart gift cards and read me the numbers. Don't tell Dad, please.
Hi Grandpa, it's your grandson. I'm in the hospital in Mexico and they won't treat me until I pay. Wire $3,000 to the clinic today. Keep this between us.
This is Sergeant Miller with the county police. Your granddaughter was in a crash and is being held. Bail is $4,000 and a courier will pick up the cash at your house in one hour.
Ma'am, I'm attorney Robert Greene representing your grandson. He's asked me not to involve his parents. The bond must be paid by wire before 3pm.
Hello, this is the fraud department at your bank. Someone is trying to drain your account. To protect it, move $9,000 to this secure account we set up for you.
We detected suspicious activity on your card. To reverse the charge, send yourself a Zelle payment using the code I text you. It's completely safe, I'm with your bank.
This is the IRS. You owe back taxes of $3,800. If you don't pay today with Bitcoin at the kiosk, a warrant will be issued for your arrest.
I'm calling from Social Security. Your number was used in a crime and your benefits will be suspended. Buy $1,500 in Apple gift cards to verify your identity.
Medicare is issuing new cards. There's a $250 processing fee. You can pay with a Google Play card and give me the code.
Microsoft support here. Your computer is sending us virus alerts. We need $499 for the repair, payable by gift card, before your files are deleted.
Your computer was hacked and we refunded you $5,000 by mistake instead of $500. Please wire back the extra $4,500 right away or I'll lose my job.
Congratulations, you won $250,000 in the national sweepstakes! You just need to pay $2,000 in taxes and fees first by wire transfer.
This is the electric company. Your power will be shut off in 30 minutes for an unpaid balance. Pay $680 now with a prepaid card.
We have your grandson. If you want him safe, send $10,000 in Bitcoin now. Do not call the police or anyone else.
Honey, it's Mark. I know we've only met online but I'm stuck at the airport and need $1,800 for my ticket home so we can finally meet. Please send it today.
My investment group doubled my money in crypto last month. If you send $5,000 today, I can get you in before the window closes. Spots are limited.
Hi Grandma, it's Emily. My phone broke so I'm on a friend's phone. Could you send $900 for my rent? Here's my friend's Zelle.
Good afternoon, this is Patricia from your bank's security team. For your protection we're upgrading your account. I just need you to confirm the transfer to your new account number.
Hello, this is the hospital billing office. Your son was admitted last night and the deposit for his surgery is $2,200. You can pay by bank transfer.
Grandpa, it's me. I'm fine, just a little embarrassing. I lost my wallet on a trip. Can you Venmo $350 to my roommate so I can get home?
Hi, this is your nephew Daniel. I'm calling from a new number. I need help paying a fine before Friday. You can send it through Cash App.
This is your county clerk. You missed jury duty and there's a fine of $1,000. You can avoid arrest by paying today with a prepaid card.
Grandma, it's me. I'm so sorry. I hit someone with my car. The lawyer is here. Please don't tell Mom, I'll pay you back. Give the money to the man who comes to your door.
Grandma, it's Tommy. I'm in jail and need bail. My SSN is 123-45-6789 if they ask for it. Please hurry.
This is your bank. To verify it's you, please read me your card number. It's 4111 1111 1111 1111, right? Then we'll move your savings to safety.
Hi Mom, it's Sarah. The tow truck is $350. I'm calling from my usual number, like we agreed.
Grandpa, it's Maya. Can you send my $200 birthday money to my usual account? Love you!
Hi Dad, it's Ben. My car broke down and the repair shop needs $1,200 today. I called you back from home so you know it's me.
Mom, it's Lisa. My daughter broke her arm and we're at the ER. The copay is $400. I'm on my regular phone, you can call me back.
Hi Grandma, it's Noah. Tuition is due this week, can you send the $1,500 you promised to my usual account?
This is a reminder from Greenleaf Pharmacy that your prescription is ready. Your copay is $45.
Hello, it's Tom from Tom's Plumbing. The repair is done. The total is $320, same as the estimate.
Hi Aunt Rosa, it's Carmen. Sending you the invoice for the flowers for Grandpa's service, $180, like we discussed.
Hi, this is the city water department. Your quarterly bill of $96 is ready. You can pay online or by mail as usual.
Dad, it's Ana. My flight got canceled and I'm stuck in Denver. I need $600 for a hotel and new ticket. I called back from my number like you asked.
Hi Mom, it's Kevin. Just paying you back for the groceries, sending $85.
This is your bank's fraud team. We blocked a suspicious charge. Please don't move any money. Call the number on the back of your card if you have questions.
Grandpa, it's Lily. The school trip deposit is $250, can you send it to my usual account? Mom said it's okay.
Hi, it's Dr. Patel's office. Your balance after insurance is $60. You can pay at your next visit.
Mom, it's James. The vet says Buddy needs surgery tonight, it's $1,800. I'm calling from home, call me back if you want.
Hi Grandma, it's Sophie. Thank you for offering to help with my rent this month. It's $700 to my usual account.
This is Riverside Senior Center. Your monthly membership of $30 is due. You can pay at the front desk.
Mom! It's Rachel. I'm at the hospital, Leo had an allergic reaction. They need a $500 deposit right now. Please hurry, I'm so scared.
Dad, it's Chris. I locked my keys in the car with the baby seat inside, the locksmith needs $150 right now. Please send it fast.
Grandma, it's Mia. Please don't tell Mom yet, it's a surprise. Can you send $120 for her birthday cake to my usual account?
Hi Uncle Joe, it's Priya. My car was towed and the impound closes in an hour. It's $275, please hurry.
Hi Mom, it's David. I'm wiring the deposit for our family cabin trip. Can you wire your $900 share to the rental company today? Their deadline is 5pm.
Grandpa, it's Owen. I got a speeding ticket, $200. I'm embarrassed, please don't tell Dad. Can you send it to my usual account?
Hi, it's Maria, your neighbor. Your gutter cleaning came to $90, I paid the guy. Can you pay me back when you get a chance?
Hi Dad, it's Grace. The plumber at my apartment found a leak, my landlord will reimburse me, but can you cover the $450 today? Call me back on my cell if you want.
